'''First Anthology''' is the 10th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in May 1997. It is the first of three anthology boxes. It contains six '''white-bordered preview''' cards from [[Special Edition]] (3 Light Side and 3 Dark Side), including [[Boba Fett (First Anthology)]], the first printing of the Special Edition Boba Fett. MSRP $32.00.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="wook">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/First_Anthology First Anthology] at Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230304002322/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/First_Anthology Internet Archive]</ref>

The six cards became tournament-legal with this product and were later printed with black borders in Special Edition (November 1998);<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=11 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia Rev. 3.2], page 11. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> four of them (Boba Fett, Commander Wedge Antilles, Hit And Run and X-wing Assault Squadron) were reworded for that printing. On this wiki each is titled by its product, for example [[Boba Fett (First Anthology)]]. The box is an 800-card storage box. It also held two Premiere Unlimited starter decks, two [[A New Hope Limited]] packs, two [[Hoth Limited]] packs and one [[Jedi Pack]]. A rules supplement covered A New Hope through Dagobah. Those randomized packs and starters are reprints and are not listed here.<ref name="encyc" />
